findings.title: HKMA hosts CargoX Solution Day to promote regional trade data connectivity

rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 6 October 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 HKMA signals a regional trade-data connectivity expansion: CargoX Connect has enabled five pilot banks to use Yangtze River Delta trade-declaration data for trade verification and counterparty due diligence, supporting SME trade-finance loan drawdowns. The update is a market-infrastructure programme development, not a new participation or compliance requirement. Hong Kong 🟡 HKMA hosts CargoX Solution Day to promote regional trade data connectivity 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20261005-hkma-press-94ed66925e ⏰ Deadline: No source deadline stated Products: SME trade lending, digital trade data, cross-border trade finance The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) reported that it held a CargoX Solution Day and signed a memorandum of understanding with the PAA Digital Trade Alliance to promote trade-finance digitalisation. HKMA said CargoX Connect links the Commercial Data Interchange with a Shanghai Data Bureau digital-trade platform, enabling five pilot banks to use Yangtze River Delta trade-declaration data for trade verification and counterparty due diligence. HKMA says the pilot has enabled approval of ten trade-finance loans totalling HK$180 million, and intends to extend the model to other Mainland provinces and cities. This is a market-infrastructure programme update rather than a new requirement or supervisory expectation; the release does not state a participation mandate, data-access terms, customer-consent conditions, underwriting criteria or control standards. Source: HKMA hosts CargoX Solution Day to promote regional trade data connectivity SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. No qualifying benchmark developments were included in this edition. Watch List • Monitor HKMA announcements for the next-phase CargoX participation model, including any stated eligibility, data-access, consent or cross-border data arrangements.
